targetTexts.1: The proverbs of Solomon: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish son grief to his mother.
targetTexts.2: Ill-gotten treasures profit nothing, but righteousness brings deliverance from death.
targetTexts.3: The LORD does not let the righteous go hungry, but He denies the craving of the wicked.
targetTexts.4: Idle hands make one poor, but diligent hands bring wealth.
targetTexts.5: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during harvest is a disgraceful son.
targetTexts.6: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
targetTexts.7: The memory of the righteous is a blessing, but the name of the wicked will rot.
targetTexts.8: A wise heart will receive commandments, but foolish lips will come to ruin.
targetTexts.9: He who walks in integrity walks securely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
targetTexts.10: He who winks the eye causes grief, and foolish lips will come to ruin.
targetTexts.11: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
targetTexts.12: Hatred stirs up dissension, but love covers all transgressions.
targetTexts.13: Wisdom is found on the lips of the discerning, but a rod is for the back of him who lacks judgment.
targetTexts.14: The wise store up knowledge, but the mouth of the fool invites destruction.
targetTexts.15: The wealth of the rich man is his fortified city, but poverty is the ruin of the poor.
targetTexts.16: The labor of the righteous leads to life, but the gain of the wicked brings punishment.
targetTexts.17: Whoever heeds instruction is on the path to life, but he who ignores reproof goes astray.
targetTexts.18: The one who conceals hatred has lying lips, and whoever spreads slander is a fool.
targetTexts.19: When words are many, sin is unavoidable, but he who restrains his lips is wise.
targetTexts.20: The tongue of the righteous is choice silver, but the heart of the wicked has little worth.
targetTexts.21: The lips of the righteous feed many, but fools die for lack of judgment.
targetTexts.22: The blessing of the LORD enriches, and He adds no sorrow to it.
targetTexts.23: The fool delights in shameful conduct, but a man of understanding has wisdom.
targetTexts.24: What the wicked man dreads will overtake him, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
targetTexts.25: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked are no more, but the righteous are secure forever.
targetTexts.26: Like vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, so is the slacker to those who send him.
targetTexts.27: The fear of the LORD prolongs life, but the years of the wicked will be cut short.
targetTexts.28: The hope of the righteous is joy, but the expectations of the wicked will perish.
targetTexts.29: The way of the LORD is a refuge to the upright, but destruction awaits those who do evil.
targetTexts.30: The righteous will never be shaken, but the wicked will not inhabit the land.
targetTexts.31: The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom, but a perverse tongue will be cut out.
targetTexts.32: The lips of the righteous know what is fitting, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.
